x.hook: Running basis trades across fragmented books guarantees liquidation during volatility.
x.copy:
Running basis trades across fragmented books guarantees liquidation during volatility. You have long spot on one book and short perps on another. One leg gets margin-called while your capital sits idle elsewhere.

SmartAccount sandboxes solve this on Soroban. Net margin stays unified across positions with a hard 1.10x Health Factor floor, verified via ~320ms Mercury indexer latency and 0.00014 XLM fixed gas.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

linkedin.hook: Why fragmented margin architectures liquidate solvent delta-neutral strategies.
linkedin.copy:
Capital efficiency in systematic trading routinely breaks down at execution boundaries. Arbitrage, delta-neutral basis, and funding rate capture require traders to split collateral across discrete venues. When market dislocations occur, these strategies face synthetic liquidation. One leg gets wiped out due to localized margin exhaustion while surplus capital sits locked on the offsetting venue.

Vanna addresses this by implementing programmable SmartAccounts on Stellar Soroban. Instead of routing trades through monolithic pooled risk engines, credit lines attach directly to isolated SmartAccount sandboxes. Capital across positions acts as unified collateral. Margin health is calculated holistically against a deterministic 1.10x Health Factor floor, indexed via Mercury with ~320ms state latency and 0.00014 XLM execution cost.

This design delivers on-chain prime brokerage mechanics without introducing shared pool contagion. Systematic firms can run basis and perp arbitrage strategies with unified cross-collateralization while lenders remain ring-fenced inside modular vaults. Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

Institutional architecture is documented at test.stellar.vanna.finance

reddit.hook: Technical breakdown: How we built isolated SmartAccount sandboxes on Soroban to kill basis trade liquidations
reddit.copy:
If you trade cash and carry, funding rate arb, or delta-neutral spreads across decentralized venues, you already know how bad collateral fragmentation is. Your net position is flat, but a sudden wick on your short perpetual position pushes you into liquidation while your spot collateral sits completely idle in another contract. You take a realized loss on a trade that was fundamentally solvent.

We engineered Vanna around this exact failure mode using Soroban smart contracts.

### The Architecture

Rather than forcing users to deposit into a shared, monolithic lending pool that manages execution centrally, Vanna deploys user-controlled SmartAccounts. Each SmartAccount acts as an isolated sandbox with direct credit facility integration.

1. State Verification and Indexing: The account state is continuously reconciled using a Mercury indexer pipeline operating at ~320ms latency. This ensures real-time recognition of open position values across integrated execution endpoints.

2. Margin Valuation: The engine enforces a unified 1.10x Health Factor floor. Because collateral and debt live within the single SmartAccount perimeter, the risk engine nets long and short legs locally instead of treating each position as an independent liability.

3. Cost Structure: Soroban allows predictable sub-cent operational overhead. Executions, collateral top-ups, and balance rebalances run at approximately 0.00014 XLM fixed gas cost, avoiding the priority fee spikes that make automated rebalancing fail on other networks during sharp liquidations.

### Testing It on Testnet

You can verify the contract logic and run integration scripts right now. Head over to the deployment portal, connect a testnet wallet, generate an isolated SmartAccount, and run multi-leg positions against our mocked execution targets.

Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

Disclosure: I am a core contributor working on Vanna Protocol.
